faqs: What is a Linktree and why do I need one?

One link to share everything you do, make and sell. Put it in your Instagram, TikTok or YouTube bio, in an email signature, or on a printed QR code, and people land on a single page with all your links.

LinktreeIsDead is a free, open-source take on that idea. Its code is on GitHub.

Yes. Pick a theme, button style and shape, and see the result in a live preview as you change it.

Advanced fonts, video backgrounds and custom layouts are not built yet.
Can I make money with a Linktree?
Not directly. There is no checkout, affiliate marketplace or sponsored-link program here. You can link out to your own shop, course or tip jar like any other link.
What tools are included with Linktree to grow and engage my audience?
Page views, link clicks and click-through rate for the last 14 days, plus a ranked list of your top links. Email collection, scheduling and Instagram automation are not built yet.
Is Linktree safe to use on all social media platforms?
Your page is a normal, lightweight web page with no tracking scripts on your visitors, so you can share the link anywhere a link is allowed.
No. There are no payments, fees or plans. The project is free and open source.
Do I need a website to use Linktree?
No. Your page lives at one short link, so it can stand in for a website or sit alongside one.
Can I have multiple Linktrees, or use Linktree as a team?
Each account has one page today. Team seats and multiple pages are not built yet; contributions are welcome on GitHub.
Where can I download the Linktree app?
There is no app store app. Open the site in your phone's browser and add it to your home screen.
